name: Watermark
summary: A layer of the same word, repeated across a box, to say that what is underneath is a copy. The word is real text in the markup, tiled by the browser rather than baked into a picture.
summaryZh: 同一句话重复铺满一整块,说明底下的东西是副本。这句话是标记里真正的文字,由浏览器平铺,不是烤进图片里的。

variants.name: Diagonal
variants.note: The tiles lean, which is the watermark everyone expects. The base class on its own is already this.

variants.name: Upright
variants.note: The tiles stand upright, for a document that is read rather than glanced at.

sizes.name: Small
sizes.note: A tight lattice: the word is smaller and the tiles sit closer together, so the box needs more of them to be covered.

sizes.name: Medium
sizes.note: The default lattice needs no modifier class.

sizes.name: Large
sizes.note: A loose lattice: the word is larger and the tiles sit further apart, so a few of them cover the box.

parts.name: Layer
parts.note: The layer the tiles sit in. It is hidden from the reader and takes no pointer, so the content underneath stays usable.

parts.name: Tile
parts.note: One word of the watermark. The layer repeats as many of them as the box needs.

parts.name: Content
parts.note: What the watermark is painted over. It sits above the layer, so the word never stands between the reader and the text.

props.name: rows
props.description: How many rows of tiles to write.

props.name: columns
props.description: How many tiles to write in each row.

props.name: variant
props.description: Whether the tiles lean or stand upright.
props.descriptionZh: 水印是倾斜的还是平铺的。

props.name: size
props.description: How far apart the tiles sit.

slots.name: default
slots.description: The content the watermark is painted over.

a11y.notes: The watermark is decoration and says nothing the content does not already say, so the layer is hidden from the reader with aria-hidden and takes no pointer events. The word is real text rather than a picture, so it is still selectable by a reader who wants to copy it — and it can be translated, which a baked-in picture could not be. Put the word in the content too, if the reader has to know it: a watermark nobody can read is not a notice.
a11y.notesZh: 水印是装饰,并不比内容多说一个字,所以水印层用 aria-hidden 藏起来,也不吃指针事件。这句话是真的文字,不是图片,所以想复制的读者仍然可以选它 —— 而且它可以被翻译,烤进图片里的字不行。如果读者必须知道这句话,也把它写进内容里:没人看得见的水印不是通知。

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: A word repeated across a box. The tiles are written out in the markup and the layer flows them into a lattice; the content sits above them.
examples.descriptionZh: 一句话铺满一整块。水印在标记里一个个写出来,水印层把它们排成格子;内容压在它们上面。

examples.descriptionZh: 水印要么倾斜,要么平铺。倾斜的是基础类,因为基础类本来就是倾斜的。

examples.description: Three lattices. The middle one is the base class on its own. The size is the distance between the tiles and the size of the word, so a tighter lattice needs more of them to cover the same box.
examples.descriptionZh: 三种间距。中间那个只写基础类。尺寸是水印之间的距离,所以排得越密,盖住同一块地方就越需要多写几个。

notes: The tile is real text, and the repetition is in the markup: a gradient paints bands and not glyphs, and a word baked into an SVG would need a font the library does not ship — and could not be translated. So the host writes the tiles out and the layer flows them into a lattice, which is the same thing a picture would have done, except that the word stays a word. The word is painted in the placeholder role, which is the only role the contract has for text that is deliberately faint; a role of its own would be better, and is worth adding to the contract.
notesZh: 水印是真的文字,重复这件事写在标记里:渐变画出来的是条纹,不是字形,而把一句话烤进 SVG 就得带上库里并不存在的字体 —— 而且那句话也没法翻译。所以由使用方把水印一个个写出来,水印层把它们排成格子,和图片干的是同一件事,区别只在于这句话仍然是话。这句话用的是 placeholder 那个角色 —— 契约里唯一为「故意画得很淡的文字」准备的角色;给它一个自己的角色会更好,值得加进契约里。
